metadata.title: NOAA TC PRIMED Phase 1F Scientific Consistency & Reconciliation Summary

r5_scientific_audit.definition: Radius of mean tangential winds of 5 knots at 850 hPa level
r5_scientific_audit.distinction_from_radius_profile: R5 is a time series along storm track; radius (30 bins, 2-118 km) is spatial profile coordinate

future_targets_and_ri.future_coordinates_source: Sequential Best Track time series in environmental/storm_metadata or external ATCF files

environmental_leakage_audit.future_leakage_risk: Using nearest synoptic time causes future information leakage in ~50% of overpasses
environmental_leakage_audit.operational_recommendation: Use past synoptic slice only (t_env <= t_overpass) or pre-initialized forecast runs

R5 Extraction & Outer Wind Size Role.decision: Extract R5 as a 1D time-series scalar metric of outer tropical cyclone size (radius of 5-kt tangential wind at 850 hPa in degrees latitude), strictly separated from the 30-bin spatial brightness temperature radial profile coordinate.
R5 Extraction & Outer Wind Size Role.evidence: NetCDF inspection confirms R5 has dimension ('R5_time',) and units 'degrees_latitude'. The 30-element coordinate 'radius' (km) belongs exclusively to 'brightness_temperature_mean_radial_profile'.

Infrared Multi-Source Resolution Distinc.decision: Explicitly distinguish CIRA/STAR McIDAS (flag 1, 4-km nominal Mercator, 480x640) from HURSAT-B1 ISCCP (flag 2, 8-km nominal Equal-Area, 301x301) and handle their differing sensor-specific vs. broad thermal bands.
Infrared Multi-Source Resolution Distinc.evidence: Empirical audit confirms CIRA/STAR is 4-km (480x640) with sensor-specific central wavelengths (e.g. 10.7, 11.2, 11.5 um); HURSAT-B1 is 8-km (301x301) with broad thermal window bands (10.7-12.1 um, 10.3-12.6 um).

Temporal Synchronization Window.decision: A +/-15 min temporal coincidence window accepts 85.06% (1,924 / 2,262) of valid overpasses with a median absolute offset of 4.50 min. For high-frequency intensity change tasks, this provides clean physical consistency.
Temporal Synchronization Window.evidence: Rigorous calculation shows signed mean offset is +0.19 min (due to cancellation), mean absolute offset is 12.84 min, median absolute offset is 4.50 min, and 94.43% fall within +/-60 min.

Geostationary Platform & Sensor Harmoniz.decision: Harmonize naming variations across geostationary platforms and instruments using exact total denominator N = 2,262 valid overpasses.
Geostationary Platform & Sensor Harmoniz.evidence: Previous report sum of 2,269 was an artifact of unharmonized string splits. Harmonized counts resolve exactly to 2,262 overpasses across 27 platforms.

Train / Validation / Test Stratified Par.decision: Rebalance split from distorted 42/16/22 (52.5% train) to exact 56 Train (70.0%), 12 Val (15.0%), and 12 Test (15.0%) storm-level partition with zero cyclone overlap.
Train / Validation / Test Stratified Par.evidence: Legacy split over-allocated to val/test due to independent integer rounding on 24 small strata. Global rebalancing restores exact 70/15/15 target with perfect balance across all 6 basins and 4 eras.

Future Intensity Change Targets.decision: Use continuous intensity changes (delta V at +6, +12, +18, +24 hours) as primary regression targets. Document missingness (13.1% to 31.4%) as physical storm dissipation / tracking termination.
Future Intensity Change Targets.evidence: Availability is 86.9% (+6h), 80.4% (+12h), 74.2% (+18h), and 68.6% (+24h). Missing values reflect cyclone end-of-life rather than data corruption.

Future Track Location Targets.decision: Do not attempt to extract future storm coordinates from overpass NetCDF files. Future track coordinates must be extracted from sequential Best Track records in environmental/storm_metadata or external ATCF decks.
Future Track Location Targets.evidence: Overpass NetCDF files contain only contemporaneous center coordinates (time of overpass). Future positions are absent from overpass metadata.

Rapid Intensification Operational Thresh.decision: Define Rapid Intensification strictly as 24-hour intensity change >= 30 kt. Treat as an extreme-class imbalance task (2.91% prevalence) requiring specialized classification loss or sampling strategies.
Rapid Intensification Operational Thresh.evidence: Exact calculation across 1,784 valid 24-hour intensity changes reveals 52 positive RI events (2.91% prevalence), heavily concentrated in CP basin and modern era.

Joint Multimodal Co-occurrence Architect.decision: Design modular model architecture accepting 3 primary tiers: Core (PMW+IR+GPROF+ENV, 79.8%), MW-only (PMW+GPROF+ENV, 12.1%), and Complete (PMW+IR+GPROF+Radar+ENV, 7.1%).
Joint Multimodal Co-occurrence Architect.evidence: Joint availability matrix across all 2,599 overpasses confirms 79.76% have simultaneous PMW+IR+GPROF, and 7.12% include spaceborne precipitation radar.

Environmental Reanalysis Temporal Causal.decision: Prohibit selecting the nearest 6-hourly synoptic reanalysis slice for operational forecasting models. Restrict environmental input to past slices (t_env <= t_overpass) or pre-initialized numerical weather prediction forecasts.
Environmental Reanalysis Temporal Causal.evidence: Selecting the nearest synoptic slice causes future temporal leakage in 51.5% of overpasses (mean offset +1.50 hours ahead of overpass).

Common 256x256 at 4 km Uniform Cartesian.decision: Reject the assumption that a 256x256 grid at 4 km resolution provides 800 km radial coverage in all directions. A 256x256 grid has width 1,024 km, covering only r <= 512 km from center.
Common 256x256 at 4 km Uniform Cartesian.evidence: Geometric analysis proves covering 800 km in all directions requires a domain width of at least 1,600 km (400x400 at 4 km resolution). A 256x256 grid truncates outer synoptic flow and outer spiral bands.

Alternative Spatial Grid Representations.decision: Evaluate 400x400 Cartesian (1,600 km domain at 4 km), nested multiresolution (256x256 at 2 km core + 256x256 at 8 km outer), and storm-centered polar grids (160 radial x 360 azimuthal bins) in Phase 2 preprocessing.
Alternative Spatial Grid Representations.evidence: Each candidate trades off computational complexity (memory/GPU FLOPs) against physical fidelity (outer rainband capture, mass-conserving precipitation fluxes).
